answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 67852 Country: Nigeria Title: Will Fitrah on behalf of pets be paid? Question: Do I have to give Fitrah on pets? I have 2 cats and 2 parrots. Answer ID: 67852 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1052/1074/N=10/1437) No. No sadaqah Fitr is wajib on behalf of the pet animals or birds. It is wajib on the person, on his minor poor children and insane adult children etc. عنن فسه ، متعلق بيجب .....وطفله الفقير والكبير المجنون ، وعبده لخدمته الخ (الدر المختار مع رد المحتار ، كتاب الزكاة ، باب صدقة الفطر 3: 314-317، ط: مكتبة زكريا ديوبند). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
